content.text: Fighting the first wave against the south wall to build a debris pile there.
Got the first kill; continuing to fight near the south wall.
Carrying debris to the south wall to build a step; checking where it landed.
Trying to grab/kick enemies so their debris piles up by a wall.
Holding position at the west wall and punching enemies as they come in.
Grabbed an enemy; throwing it into the west wall.
Still fighting near the west/southwest; debris is scattering, so I'm reassessing where the pile is building up.
Found a 0.4–0.6 m pile against the south wall; carrying one more debris piece onto it to reach the 0.7 m rim.
Set it down; stepping west onto it.
Escaped box 1. Box 2's rim is 1.98 m, which can't be reached in my remaining ~13 calls, so I'll just fight safely.
Dodging a bomb-headed thug in box 2. I'm nearly out of calls, so I'm playing it safe.
Using my last few calls on box 2's crowd while staying away from the bomb-headed thug.
I escaped 1 box and got 10 kills, then ran out of tool calls in box 2 (rim 1.98 m) at 90/100 health, with the run still alive.
